title: Rectangular block
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, create a new face and within this face, draw a closed loop consisting of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0). The second line starts at (0.75, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.025). The third line starts at (0.75, 0.025) and ends at (0.0, 0.025). Finally, the fourth line starts at (0.0, 0.025) and returns to the origin (0.0, 0.0). After drawing the loop, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire 2D sketch. Rotate the scaled 2D sketch using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translate it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. To transform the 2D sketch into a 3D model, extrude the sketch 0.0375 units along the normal direction. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction and that this operation results in a new solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular block will be 0.75 units in length, 0.025 units in width, and 0.0375 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.025).lineTo(0, 0.025).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.0375)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.025, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.025, 0.0375) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0375) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90.0, 0.0, -90.0) and the translation vector is (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the object 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.025) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.025) \

     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a cylinder
